definitions.explanation: Taking a leading role in guiding or directing an activity, project, or process. Often used in organizational, political, or business contexts.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}{主導|しゅどう}の{計画|けいかく}だ。
このプロジェクトは{田中|たなか}さんが{主導|しゅどう}している。
{民間|みんかん}{企業|きぎょう}が{主導|しゅどう}する{技術|ぎじゅつ}{開発|かいはつ}が{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: Technology development led by private companies is attracting attention.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～{主導|しゅどう}の (led by ~, ~-led)
- {主導|しゅどう}{権|けん} (initiative, leadership)
- {主導|しゅどう}{権|けん}を{握|にぎ}る (to seize the initiative)
- ～が{主導|しゅどう}する (to lead, to take the lead in)

Used frequently in news and formal writing. The compound {主導|しゅどう}{権|けん} specifically refers to the power or right to lead.
